intent: Technical Brief: ASUS TUF Gaming A17 Sleep/Power Issues
detected_fault: Sleep/Power Issues (Keyboard lights remain on after waking from sleep, brief screen flash followed by BSOD with error message "Critical Process Died")
suggested_solution: Run System File Checker (SFC) to scan and repair corrupted system files.
Update all drivers, including AMD, NVIDIA, and ASUS drivers.
Run Windows Troubleshooters to identify and fix potential issues.
Perform a clean boot by disabling all startup programs and services.
